item.title: A private Strava setup journey
item.summary: Starting or repairing Strava now uses one durable Connect journey instead of asking you to copy developer credentials into Murph.
item.details: Murph gives the private application a distinct friendly name, creates or recovers only that exact application, seals credentials without displaying them, and continues with read-only OAuth. Strava may first require a developer subscription or provider prerequisite; when it does, Connect offers Continue in Strava or a safe pre-submission cancellation. Progress remains saved across sign-in, consent, retry, disconnect, and deletion. This release records checked-in workflow and deterministic fake-provider validation; it does not claim external production launch proof.
